_comment: Tier-2 for dune::poisson (solver string not validated in Python). dune/fem/discretefunction/_solvers.py::femsolver forwards the `solver=` string unchecked as the C++ parameter 'linear.method'; the guard is DUNE's parameter reader, so a plausible name fails at scheme construction with an error naming a parameter the caller never wrote. The fixture harvests that message rather than trusting docs: it asserts the rejection, that the message still names 'fem.solver.linear.method', and that it still enumerates gmres/cg/bicgstab — then proves each advertised name actually solves. Verified by execution against dune-fem 2.12.0.2 on 2026-08-03: solver='conjugate_gradient' -> RuntimeError "ParameterInvalid [getEnumeration:.../dune/fem/io/parameter/reader.hh:300]: Parameter 'fem.solver.linear.method' invalid. Valid values are: gmres, cg, bicgstab".
